_comment: Fixture doc-unit inventory for the #7537 census cases in
check_rustdoc_links_selftest.sh. Same feature set as metadata-mini.json, so
lanes-mini.tsv covers it exactly and the coverage arms stay quiet; what this
one adds is `targets`, which is what the census reads.
Expected doc units: demo (lib) and demo-cli (bin). The other three are the
gate's three drop rules, one fixture row each: `demo` the BIN collides with
`demo` the lib and cargo documents the lib instead; `demo-heavy` needs a
feature `default` does not reach; a test target is no doc unit at all.
the transitive walk `tm`'s own required-features made necessary.
